subject: Re: MAP + ingestion plan for evaluation kit (datasets, prompts, testcases)
messages:
From: Alice Green <alice.green@acme-corp.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: eval-team@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + dataset delivery — ready to schedule

Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's MAP yesterday. We're ready to proceed with the evaluation kit exchange so our engineering team can start ingestion tests next week. Two quick asks before we lock a date:

- Confirm the allowed usage for the prompt pack (can we use it for fine-tuning experiments in a closed sandbox?)
- Provide the expected delivery package (file list + checksums) and a signed MAP draft or an indication of any outstanding legal points we should route to our procurement team.

Ideal timeline from our side: start ingestion in your sandbox on Monday 9/20, run smoke tests 9/21–9/22, and share initial feedback by EOD 9/23. If that works, we'll route a single PO and a redline doc to you today.

Appreciate it — we want to minimize back-and-forth so the ingestion window is useful for our SREs.

Best,
Alice
Alice Green
Head of ML Platform, Acme Corporation
On behalf of the ACME Evaluation Team
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Green <alice.green@acme-corp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + dataset delivery — ready to schedule

Alice — thanks, this is great. Short answers up front and then a proposed plan: 

1) Prompt pack usage: allowed for evaluation and closed-sandbox experiments only; no external distribution or posting. Fine-tuning of a private model is permitted while the sandbox is isolated and the artifacts remain behind your VPC. We will add an explicit sandbox expiry clause (default 90 days) in the MAP but can extend by request.

2) Delivery package: attached is our current MAP (redwood-mpa-v3.pdf) and a sample manifest. Attachment stub: redwood-mpa-v3.pdf (MAP v3, includes usage guardrails). We will also provide a promptpack sample (promptpack-sample.zip) via a gated Drive link.

Proposed schedule (assuming we get your PO + redlines today):
- 9/15: DocuSign MAP + delivery manifest (we'll provide checksums)
- 9/20: SFTP/Drive transfer of datasets + prompt pack to your sandbox account
- 9/20–9/22: Ingestion and smoke tests (your SRE)
- 9/23: Joint sync to review results and agree on acceptance criteria next steps

Action items for ACME: send PO and the redline doc (we can accept a single consolidated redlines file). For legal questions, copy liz. We will get Dev to create a temporary sandbox user and share credentials and SFTP details once DocuSign completes.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and linking the sample prompt pack.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-mpa-v3.pdf (attachment stub); promptpack-sample.zip (drive link)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Green <alice.green@acme-corp.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, liz.hewitt@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-09-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + dataset delivery — licensing and retention clarifications

Hi Alice / Vanessa — looping in a couple clarifications from our side so ACME's legal/procurement have everything up front.

- Prompt pack: we restrict distribution outside the evaluation sandbox. Derivative outputs (model checkpoints) remain ACME property for evaluation, but Redwood's MAP requires that any public release of derivative models that used the prompt pack must notify Redwood and comply with the usage covenant in section 4.2. If ACME wants a wider license, we can discuss a separate commercial license.

- Data retention: the default sandbox TTL is 90 days. We can automate a 7-day removal window after expiration; if you need longer retention for regression testing, provide the requested window in the PO and we will create a change request in the MAP.

- Checksums and ingest manifest: we'll provide SHA256 checksums and an ingestion manifest at transfer time. Please confirm the SFTP host and the user naming convention (we tend to provision sandbox-user-acme-<short-id>).

I'll also prepare a short insertion into the MAP that explicitly lists allowed tooling (no public model-hosting, keys tied to ACME account) to avoid ambiguity.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Lead, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Green <alice.green@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liz Hewitt <liz.hewitt@acme-corp.com>, eval-team@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-09-14T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + dataset delivery — licensing and retention clarifications

Thanks Karthik — that addresses most of our questions. A couple of notes from procurement/legal: 

- We're attaching a single redline doc with a small set of edits (acme-redlines.docx). High level: request to add a 120-day option for sandbox retention, and a clarification that derivative checkpoints produced in the sandbox are owned by ACME for internal use only (no public release without mutual consent).
- We can accept the SHA256 checksums and SFTP flow. Our SREs prefer the username pattern your suggested.

If you can incorporate the 120-day option as an opt-in and provide the DocuSign envelope by EOD 9/15, we'll route signature on Monday 9/20 and expect to start ingestion 9/21 (shifted one day due to internal calendar).

Thanks — sending the redline now.

— Alice
Attachment: acme-redlines.docx (redlines sent)
